source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate && python3 << 'PYTHON_SCRIPT'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Data from N=16 fixed pooled IRT results
# vanilla_2pl vs 2pl_gamma, same models, same benchmarks
benchmarks = ['MMLU', 'ARC-C', 'GSM8K']
raw_mae    = [0.0155, 0.0338, 0.1694]
vanilla_mae = [0.0068, 0.0158, 0.0063]
gamma_mae   = [0.0072, 0.0201, 0.0062]

x = np.arange(len(benchmarks))
width = 0.25

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(4.5, 3.2))

bars_raw = ax.bar(x - width, raw_mae, width, label='Raw Scores', 
                  color='#888888', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
bars_vanilla = ax.bar(x, vanilla_mae, width, label='Vanilla 2PL',
                      color='#4878CF', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
bars_gamma = ax.bar(x + width, gamma_mae, width, label=r'2PL+$\gamma$',
                    color='#E8853F', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)

ax.set_ylabel('MAE (Mean Absolute Error)', fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('Benchmark', fontsize=9)
ax.set_title('IRT-Based Calibration vs Raw Scores', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(benchmarks, fontsize=9)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)

# Add value labels on top of bars
def add_labels(bars, fontsize=7):
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax.annotate(f'{height:.3f}',
                    xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                    xytext=(0, 2),
                    textcoords="offset points",
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=fontsize)

add_labels(bars_raw)
add_labels(bars_vanilla)
add_labels(bars_gamma)

ax.set_ylim(0, max(raw_mae) * 1.2)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=8)
ax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

plt.tight_layout()

# Save
import os
os.makedirs('/root/autodl-tmp/artifacts', exist_ok=True)
plt.savefig('/root/autodl-tmp/artifacts/fig_calibration.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
plt.savefig('/root/autodl-tmp/artifacts/fig_calibration.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
print("Saved fig_calibration.pdf and .png")

# Verify file sizes
for f in ['/root/autodl-tmp/artifacts/fig_calibration.pdf', '/root/autodl-tmp/artifacts/fig_calibration.png']:
    sz = os.path.getsize(f)
    print(f"{f}: {sz} bytes")
